domain_definitions.Hazard: Climate variables and indices that characterise physical hazard (rainfall, temperature, drought, flood extent).
domain_definitions.Hazard / Climate Services: Operationally processed hazard products delivered as services (seasonal forecasts, advisories).
domain_definitions.Exposure: Data on agricultural systems, land use, populations, and assets exposed to climate hazards.
domain_definitions.Sensitivity: Data on how exposed systems respond to climate stressors (yield sensitivity, disease risk models).
domain_definitions.Adaptive Capacity: Data on the capacity of systems or communities to adjust to climate impacts.
domain_definitions.Adaptation Analytics: Integrated datasets and model outputs assessing adaptation options, impacts, or trade-offs.
domain_definitions.Mitigation: GHG inventories, emission factors, and tools for quantifying emission reductions in agriculture.
domain_definitions.Soil / Agronomy: Soil properties, fertility, and agronomic trial or recommendation datasets.
domain_definitions.Socio-economics: Household, market, and livelihood data used in targeting and impact analysis.
domain_definitions.Multi-domain: Assets that span two or more domains without a clear primary classification.
